messages.text: Your refund proposal is for **R$49.00** for the wooden watch box, the amount paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a reply in chat won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
The customer confirmed request prop-0407a4dfd9c34abd and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

The **R$49.00** refund has been recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Your receipt number is **R-00000001**. It is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t provide a date for when money may appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
Why is the refund R$49.00 instead of R$69.00?

The order records **R$49.00** as the amount paid for the wooden watch box, so that is the refundable amount. The refund is based on what was paid for the item, not its stated price (refund-policy/v2/amount). It has already been refunded; receipt **R-00000001** confirms the R$49.00 refund. A unit can only be refunded once (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
